pieces.Text: At 8th level, you can move through tunnels and caves with ease. Activating this ability is a standard action. You can move across any stone surface as if under the effects of spider climb. You can also see very well in darkness, gaining darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already possess darkvision, extend the range by 60 feet. While underground, you also gain a +
insight bonus on Stealth skill checks and a +
insight bonus on initiative checks. You can use this ability for
minutes per day. These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but they must be spent in 1-minute increments.
